newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Rep. Archer says Republicans want tax cuts.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Rep. Archer says Republicans want tax cuts.

text.p: House Ways and Means Committee Chairman Bill Archer said Republicans want tax cuts as part of a balanced budget, and did not comment on House leaders proposing to delay considering tax cuts.

"I think that up to this point our conference would desire that we include tax cuts as a part of the balanced budget," Archer, a Texas Republican said, "and I haven't seen any significant change on the part of the majority of our membership."
He did not comment on House Speaker Newt Gingrich endorsing the idea of putting off a major tax cut in order to reach a budget deal with President Clinton.
